tagline: We make your business the source AI answers quote
intro: We help specialist firms show up when buyers ask search engines and AI assistants for a recommendation. We write the clear, checkable pages those answers draw on, and fix whatever stops them being read.
audience: Independent professional firms in Scotland and the north of England: accountants, architects, solicitors, surveyors and specialist consultancies with five to fifty staff.
pricing_note: A fixed monthly fee, quoted after a one-hour review of your site and how AI assistants describe you today. No long contract: three months to start, then monthly.

services.title: AI answer check
services.description: We ask the major AI assistants the questions your buyers ask, record what they say about you and your competitors, and show you where you are missing or misdescribed.

services.title: Source pages
services.description: Service, pricing and question pages written with your team: specific, dated and easy to quote, so an assistant has something accurate to cite.

services.title: Technical groundwork
services.description: Crawl access, page speed, structured data, internal links and clean titles, so search engines and AI crawlers can read every page that matters.

services.title: Mentions elsewhere
services.description: Directory listings, trade bodies and industry press that assistants trust, checked for accuracy and filled in where you are absent.

process.title: Ask the questions
process.description: We put fifty real buyer questions to search engines and AI assistants and record who gets named, quoted and linked.

process.title: Write the sources
process.description: We fix the technical gaps and write the pages that answer those questions properly, approved by you before they go live.

process.title: Ask again
process.description: Every month we ask the same questions again and send you a short note on what changed, in plain language.

proof.text: They showed us exactly what the assistants were saying about us, and why it was wrong.
proof.source: Managing partner, an Edinburgh architecture practice (sample)

proof.text: The pages they wrote with us are clearer than anything we had written ourselves.
A plain monthly note that tells us what moved and what they are doing next.
